newspaper.headline: New Routers Installed, Wi-Fi Complaints Pour In
newspaper.lead: Nusa Digital replaced the routers on every floor last weekend. Since then, the IT Workshop has received many complaints about slow or missing internet.

impact.good: Yesterday, the IT Workshop didn't open a single healthy laptop, and every broken part was replaced. The spare parts store praised the new technician.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most devices were handled correctly, but some parts were replaced needlessly or missed. Pak Joko's reminder: look at the evidence first.
impact.bad: Yesterday, several laptops were opened needlessly and some damage was missed. The spare parts store is running out of stock.

tip.title: Tip: Ping from Near to Far
tip.text: Test the router first, then an internet address, then website names. If only names fail, suspect DNS.

newspaper.classified: LOST: One blue network cable, last seen under the Marketing desk. Please return it.
